hostname.title: Hostname
hostname.description: Hostname used to connect to the Amazon RDS or Aurora MySQL database.

username.title: Username
username.description: MySQL user that authenticates with IAM database authentication.

port.title: Port
port.description: Port used to connect to the database.

rds_endpoint_hostname.title: RDS endpoint hostname
rds_endpoint_hostname.description: RDS hostname used to sign IAM tokens and verify the server certificate; defaults to hostname when omitted.

rds_endpoint_port.title: RDS endpoint port
rds_endpoint_port.description: RDS port used to sign IAM tokens; defaults to port when omitted.

region.title: AWS region
region.description: AWS region of the RDS instance or Aurora cluster.

iam_role_arn.title: IAM role ARN
iam_role_arn.description: IAM role Polytomic assumes to sign database authentication tokens.

external_id.title: External ID
external_id.description: External ID Polytomic presents when assuming the IAM role.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: Session tags applied when assuming the IAM role.

change_detection.title: Use replication for bulk syncs
change_detection.description: Read changes from the binary log for bulk syncs.
